sections.heading: Online Donation
paragraphs: Support the Indian American Artists Association (IAAA) by making either recurring or one-time donation to IAAA securely through PayPal, using your credit card or bank account:

sections.heading: Donations as Memorials or Tributes
paragraphs: Indian American Artists Association would be honored to accept an in-memoriam gift from donors who find that a donation to the Association is an appropriate expression following a loss.
A donation can also be made as an expression of honoring someone you care about on a special occasion such as birthdays, retirements, weddings, anniversaries, or retirements.
To make a memorial or tribute gift as your donation, please send a notice of your memorial or tribute donation via an email to treasurer@indianamericanartists.org with the following information:
Memorial Gift: In Memory of (NAME), Address of individual receiving the notice
Tribute Gift: In Honor of (NAME) on (Name of special occasion)

sections.heading: Donate by Check
paragraphs: Please make your check payable to Indian American Artists Association and mail to:
Indian American Artists Association, 1461 Edsel Dr, Milpitas, CA 95035

sections.heading: Donate by Zelle
paragraphs: Please make a Zelle payment to artists.iaaa@gmail.com

sections.heading: Donor Advised Fund (DAF)
paragraphs: Maximize your philanthropic impact if you have a charitable investment account through your investment broker. Find out more at:

links.label: What is a Donor Advised Fund

sections.heading: Corporate Matching Programs
paragraphs: Many companies match charitable donations by their employees to encourage philanthropy. Find out whether your company will match a donation.

sections.heading: Membership Call-to-Action
paragraphs: Your art has a story. Find the community that helps it travel further.
Join a growing network of Indian-origin visual artists creating, exhibiting, and building community across the United States.
